text: Your partner cheated. Should you forgive, or should you move on? Everyone will give you an answer. Your friends will say leave. Your heart will say stay. But listen carefully. This was never a question about them. It is a question about you.

Do not ask, do they deserve forgiveness. Ask instead, can I stay without punishing them every day? Because staying while your heart keeps a knife in its hand is not forgiveness. It is a slow war. And a slow war destroys both soldiers.

And do not ask, can I live without them. You can. You lived before them. Ask instead, can I live with what I now know? Some people rebuild, and the second house is stronger than the first. Some cannot. And pretending is not strength.

Pretending is pain with patience. Ask your body, not your fear. The body always knows. Whatever you choose, you will need a quiet mind to choose it well. For forty years I have taught one way to find it. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
